title: Worms and Bone Constructs
description: A surreal dark scene inside a wooden barn or attic where a tangled mass of dark reddish-brown worms and centipede-like creatures engulfs the right side, while a broken, skeletal structure of white and blue bone-like forms covered in glowing yellow runes stands on the left, partially collapsing and connecting to the writhing mass.
prompt: Dark surreal scene set inside a dilapidated wooden barn, on the left a collapsing skeletal structure made of white and blue bone-like fragments wrapped with glowing golden runes, on the right a massive tangled mass of dark reddish-brown worms and centipedes merging with the bones, dramatic lighting, grotesque atmosphere, highly detailed, painterly style
